# T-1: Retry timeout exits

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make agent subprocess timeout exits participate in the existing bounded retry policy and preserve final failure after retries are exhausted.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A timeout/SIGTERM error is retried until retryCount is exhausted.
- Non-timeout subprocess failures keep existing retry behavior.
- Default timeout duration is unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Modify src/lib/agent.js retry classification around err.killed/err.signal without changing profile resolution or timeout configuration.

## Test Strategy
Use a spec-local unit test seam or controlled agent helper to simulate timeout errors without sleeping for 300 seconds.
